recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition layout featuring a vibrant chartreuse header with warped, custom Art Nouveau-inspired lettering above a photographic panel of a band standing in a field of yellow wildflowers, all enclosed within a thin, ornate line border with floral corner motifs.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast chartreuse background against dark green forest photography
Warped, liquid-like typography echoing the organic shapes of the wildflowers
Symmetrical framing using a thin black line with quatrefoil corner accents
Horizontal division between graphic header and photographic subject
coreInvariants: Warped, ultra-bold sans-serif lettering with liquid terminals
Thin black line border with rounded corners and floral nodes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The band occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, presented in a medium-wide shot amidst dense foliage.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large-scale, warped title text in the top third acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold header, follows the warped curves of the letters downward into the photographic field, and settles on the band members' faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with text and floral elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements contrasting with the natural, slightly muted tones of the 1960s-style photography.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical strokes are warped with a liquid, wave-like distortion
Letters are tightly kerned to the point of touching
The baseline and x-height follow a gentle arc or wave
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'S' features extreme serpentine curves
The 'A' and 'R' have closed counters that are reduced to small slits
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family custom lettering with a small, technical sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1960s concert poster aesthetic of melting letters.
Reflects the organic, floral-inspired curves of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1960s-style photograph of a four-piece band standing in a field of yellow wildflowers with a dark forest background. Place this inside a chartreuse frame with a thin black border and floral corner motifs. Leave the top third of the frame as solid chartreuse.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom, warped, ultra-bold dark green lettering to the top chartreuse section. The letters should appear to melt or flow like liquid, following a slight wave pattern.

verificationChecks: Is the chartreuse color vibrant and dominant?
Do the letters have a liquid, warped appearance?
Is the photographic style reminiscent of 1960s film?
Are the floral corner motifs present in the border?

adjustableVariables: Density of the wildflowers in the photo

mustAchieve: Organic, hand-drawn feel to the typography
Cohesive integration of graphic and photographic elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is dark green on chartreuse.
Verify the border has rounded corners with floral nodes.
Check that the photo looks like a vintage film print.
Confirm the typography fills the top panel completely.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a chartreuse graphic header featuring [warped-psychedelic-text] with a [vintage-style-photo] framed by a [floral-accented-border].
